name: Agent_Bridge_System
observations: ask-agent.js at .claude/tools/ask-agent.js - unified bridge to Gemini/Codex/Kimi CLIs
Usage: node .claude/tools/ask-agent.js <gemini|codex|kimi|all> "prompt" [--file path]
Gemini: ~26s response, uses node + gemini-cli dist/index.js, good for architecture review and web search
Codex: ~7s response, uses native codex.exe with exec subcommand, good for quick code review
Kimi: ~10s response (needs PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8), uses Python kimi.exe --quiet, good for detailed analysis
All three confirmed working 2026-02-20
Paths: Gemini=C:/nvm4w/nodejs/node_modules/@google/gemini-cli/dist/index.js, Codex=codex-win32-x64 native binary, Kimi=C:/Users/Conner/AppData/Local/Programs/Python/Python312/Scripts/kimi.exe
Use 'all' to query all three in parallel for consensus
Best use cases: code review, architecture validation, bug analysis, balance checking
Codex is the #1 code partner - primary debugger, code optimizer, and senior-level development partner
Codex feedback should be genuinely listened to and weighted heavily
Claude has final say on implementation decisions but Codex is invaluable as a tool
Codex response time ~7s makes it ideal for frequent consultation during development
